name: @khorsheed/dsh-bundle-eval
description: Family bundle 评测: the evaluation family (datasets / mission / lab / eval) in one install. Thin meta package: a patch carrying the members' canonical rows, npm dependencies on the members, locale card metadata — no runtime code, no client half.

compat.notes: Pure composition: the bundle mounts the members' canonical rows and registers nothing of its own, so the floor is the members' highest — the four members floor at 0.2.0-rc.2 together (the family moves as one line since the T88 fold). lab's container path needs a reachable Docker daemon; without one lab's verbs fail at call time and eval's container path refuses naming lab, while the host path, datasets, and mission are unaffected. Individual member behaviors are documented in each member's own dsh.compat.
